description: This file defines a PHP class 'Sql' implementing a SQL-based ID map for Drupal migration, including table creation, data lookup, and management functions.

classes.name: Sql
classes.description: Implements a SQL-based ID map for Drupal migration, managing mapping and message tables, and providing lookup and update functionalities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Sql class, setting up table names and dependencies.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the class with dependencies from the container.

methods.name: getSourceIdsHash
methods.description: Generates a SHA-256 hash of source ID values for lookup purposes.

methods.name: sourceIdFields
methods.description: Returns the mapping of source fields to internal identifiers.

methods.name: destinationIdFields
methods.description: Returns the mapping of destination fields to internal identifiers.

methods.name: mapTableName
methods.description: Returns the name of the map table.

methods.name: messageTableName
methods.description: Returns the name of the message table.

methods.name: getQualifiedMapTableName
methods.description: Returns the fully qualified name of the map table.

methods.name: getDatabase
methods.description: Provides access to the database connection, initializing if necessary.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, creating tables if they do not exist.

methods.name: setMessage
methods.description: Sets the message handler for logging.

methods.name: ensureTables
methods.description: Creates or updates the necessary database tables for mapping and messaging.

methods.name: getFieldSchema
methods.description: Creates a database schema definition from an ID field definition.

methods.name: getRowBySource
methods.description: Fetches a mapping row based on source ID values.

methods.name: getRowByDestination
methods.description: Fetches a mapping row based on destination ID values.

methods.name: getRowsNeedingUpdate
methods.description: Retrieves rows marked as needing update.

methods.name: lookupSourceId
methods.description: Finds source ID values based on destination ID values.

methods.name: lookupDestinationIds
methods.description: Finds destination ID values based on source ID values.

methods.name: saveIdMapping
methods.description: Saves a mapping between source and destination IDs.

methods.name: saveMessage
methods.description: Stores a message related to a source ID.

methods.name: getMessages
methods.description: Retrieves messages for given source IDs and level.

methods.name: prepareUpdate
methods.description: Marks all rows as needing update.

methods.name: processedCount
methods.description: Returns count of processed rows.

methods.name: importedCount
methods.description: Returns count of imported rows.

methods.name: updateCount
methods.description: Returns count of rows needing update.

methods.name: errorCount
methods.description: Returns count of failed rows.

methods.name: messageCount
methods.description: Returns count of messages.

methods.name: countHelper
methods.description: Helper method to count records in a table with optional status filtering.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a mapping and messages based on source ID values.

methods.name: deleteDestination
methods.description: Deletes mapping and messages based on destination ID values.

methods.name: setUpdate
methods.description: Marks specific source IDs as needing update.

methods.name: clearMessages
methods.description: Truncates the message table.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Drops the mapping and message tables.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Resets iteration over the mapping table.

methods.name: current
methods.description: Returns the current row in iteration.

methods.name: key
methods.description: Returns the key for the current iteration.

methods.name: currentDestination
methods.description: Returns the current destination ID values.

methods.name: currentSource
methods.description: Returns the current source ID values.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Advances to the next row in iteration.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Checks if the current row is valid.

methods.name: getHighestId
methods.description: Retrieves the highest destination ID across relevant mapping tables.
